chapter.heading: The Son Was Faithful
chapter.v:
Therefore, holy
brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Christ Jesus, [John 7:35;]

who was
faithful to Him who appointed Him, as Moses also was faithful in all His house. [Eph. 1:4]

For this
One has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as He who built the house has more honor than the house. [1 Cor. 15:20;]

For every
house is built by someone, but He who built all things is God. [Col. 1:5]

And Moses
indeed was faithful in all His house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which would be spoken afterward, [John 10:28;]

but Christ
as a Son over His own house, whose house we are if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm to the end.Be Faithful [Matt. 5:12]

Therefore, as
the Holy Spirit says:“Today, if you will hear His voice, [James 1:3 r Job]

Do not
harden your hearts as in the rebellion,In the day of trial in the wilderness, [1 John 4:20]

Where your
fathers tested Me, tried Me,And saw My works forty years.

Therefore I
was angry with that generation,And said, ‘They always go astray in their heart,And they have not known My ways.’

So I
swore in My wrath,‘They shall not enter My rest.’ ” [2 Pet. 1:21]

but exhort
one another daily, while it is called “Today,” lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

For we
have become partakers of Christ if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast to the end, [[Rom. 12:2];]

while it
is said:“Today, if you will hear His voice,Do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion.”Failure of the Wilderness Wanderers [[2 Cor. 7:1]]

For who,
having heard, rebelled? Indeed, was it not all who came out of Egypt, led by Moses? [Lev. 11:44, 45;]

Now with
whom was He angry forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose corpses fell in the wilderness? [Acts 10:34]

And to
whom did He swear that they would not enter His rest, but to those who did not obey?

So we
see that they could not enter in because of unbelief. [Acts 20:28;]
